import sys
sys.path.insert(0, '/private/tmp')
from snail_house_probe import *
from dataclasses import replace
import capstone
import collections
import difflib
import subprocess
import tempfile

D = Path('/private/tmp/snail-dip-recovery-20260913')
retained = json.loads((D / 'retained-capture.json').read_text())
baseline = json.loads((D / 'baseline.json').read_text())
config = m.load_scratch_config(ROOT / 'tools/match/scratches' / fullname('dip'))
manifest = m.load_function_symbol_manifest(m.DEFAULT_FUNCTION_SYMBOL_MANIFEST_PATH)
image_path = ROOT / manifest.primary_target
source_text = (D / 'retained.cpp').read_text()
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='snail-dip-proof-', dir='/private/tmp') as temp:
    directory = Path(temp)
    (directory / 'scratch.cpp').write_text(source_text)
    shadow = replace(config, directory=directory)
    obj = m.compile_scratch(shadow)
    candidate = m.extract_object_function(m.parse_coff_object(obj.read_bytes()), config.symbol or config.function, reference_manifest=m.load_default_reference_symbol_manifest())
    result = m.run_match(obj_path=obj, function_name=config.function, image_path=image_path, manifest=manifest, symbol_name=config.symbol, end_va=config.end_va)
    assert candidate.data.hex() == retained['raw_candidate']
    target_bytes = bytes.fromhex(retained['raw_target'])
